worldcombat.skill.mistball.summary: Knead a ball of down and mist and lob it: it deals psychic special damage and bursts into a flurry of down; half the time the down clings, sapping the target's Sp. Atk and slowing it down. The suffocating form clings longer and wider at the cost of a lighter, slower ball.
worldcombat.skill.mistball.use.0: Pin and slow a threat from range
worldcombat.skill.mistball.use.1: Sap Sp. Atk with a good chance against a special attacker
worldcombat.skill.mistball.use.2: Arc over the front line to reach the back
worldcombat.skill.mistball.description.0: The down-and-mist ball deals %1$s psychic special damage on impact.
worldcombat.skill.mistball.description.1: On a hit it has a %1$s chance to lower the target's Sp. Atk by %2$s stage(s) and leave the down clinging for %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.mistball.description.2: The ball bursts into a cloud about %1$s blocks across; at %2$s blocks/tick and %3$s blocks/tick^2 of fall it travels along an arc.
worldcombat.skill.mistball.option.on: Suffocating form: a wider cloud with a better and longer cling, at the cost of a slower ball and lower power.
worldcombat.skill.mistball.option.off: Light-feather form: more power and a faster, flatter ball, at the cost of a smaller cloud and a lower cling chance.
worldcombat.skill.mistball.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.mistball.growth.0: From level %1$s the down rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.mistball.growth.1: From level %1$s the cloud reaches %2$s blocks and the cling lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.mistball.preference.su: On: cloud radius x1.25, cling chance +0.10 and cling x1.25, at the cost of power x0.88 and lob speed x0.9, to pin one target down. Off (light-feather form): power x1.12, lob speed x1.12 and a flatter fall, at the cost of cloud x0.85 and cling chance -0.06, for a quick light hit.
worldcombat.skill.mistball.preference.ai: It only considers lobbing the ball when a threat is within this distance; smaller values keep it close, larger ones let it open from further out.
